Join the UCLA Department of Radiology, a nationally recognized leader in patient care, education, research, and innovation. The CME & Event Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the department’s educational mission by coordinating continuing medical education (CME) activities, resident and fellow programs, and a variety of academic and special events.
Coordinate educational programs and events, including resident lectures, Grand Rounds, the Physics Lecture Series, Research Day, and other departmental programs.
Manage event logistics, scheduling, speaker coordination, attendance tracking, evaluations, and educational materials.
Support CME accreditation activities and ensure compliance with applicable educational requirements and documentation standards.
Coordinate faculty and guest speaker schedules and serve as a liaison with internal and external participants.
Assist with financial, administrative, and operational activities related to educational programs and events.
Collaborate with faculty, trainees, staff, and departmental leadership to deliver high-quality learning experiences.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized and detail-oriented professional to contribute to the success of educational programs and events while supporting the academic mission of one of the nation's leading radiology departments.
